subject: Re: Cross-cloud co-sell demo — coordinating Azure + GCP SI windows
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Carter Banks <carter@cloudsi.io>; AWS Partner Enablement <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>; GCP Marketplace <gcp-marketplace@google.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cross-cloud co-sell demo — coordinating Azure + GCP SI windows

Hi Carter / partners,

Thanks for agreeing to co-sell the joint demo. A couple of constraints from our side:
- We have a preferred 60-minute slot for a combined product + SI technical run (demo + Q&A).
- Karthik and Lauren will handle the product and infra sections respectively.
- Customer pilot region is US east; we want both Azure and GCP marketplace owners on the call.

Proposed slots (PST):
1) Mon Dec 7, 11:00–12:00
2) Tue Dec 8, 09:00–10:00
3) Tue Dec 8, 14:00–15:00

I've attached a concise runbook (redwood_co-sell_runbook_v2.pdf) and an .ics with proposed times. Can you confirm availability and whether Carter wants an SI dry-run 30–45 minutes before the customer session?

If any slot doesn't work, tell us your local preferred times (Carter: you mentioned EST earlier).

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Partnerships — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0168

---

From: Carter Banks <carter@cloudsi.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Partner Enablement <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>; GCP Marketplace <gcp-marketplace@google.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 12:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Cross-cloud co-sell demo — coordinating Azure + GCP SI windows

Jordan — thanks. All three slots are potentially OK for us but a couple of notes:
- Our SI (CloudSI) prefers the Tue Dec 8 afternoon slot (14:00 PST) so our lead engineers in EST are not too early.
- We do want a 30-minute tech dry-run immediately before the customer demo; makes handoffs smoother.
- One ask: can the runbook call out two separate join links (one for dry-run, one for the customer) and include a fallback model variant for lower-latency regions?

I can do the dry-run at 13:30 PST on Tue. Also looping in AWS and GCP partners to confirm their schedulers — they sometimes need 48h notice to approve a marketplace-listed demo.

Thanks,
Carter
Director, Solutions Engineering — CloudSI
carter@cloudsi.io | +1 (917) 555-0291

From: AWS Partner Enablement <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>

Cc: GCP Marketplace <gcp-marketplace@google.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 02:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cross-cloud co-sell demo — coordinating Azure + GCP SI windows

Thanks for the invite — AWS can confirm Tue Dec 8, 14:00 PST (which is 17:00 EST) for the joint session. A few compliance notes:
- Please include a short slide (1) describing data flow and customer data residency during the demo, and (2) a line on whether any telemetry is retained by Redwood and for how long.
- We prefer a max of three speaker mics open at once to avoid audio clashes.

We will not join the 13:30 dry-run; AWS policy requires a separate enablement rehearsal that our rep will attend if scheduled separately.

Best,
AWS Partner Enablement
aws-partner-team@amazon.com

Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cross-cloud co-sell demo — coordinating Azure + GCP SI windows

Great — locking in Tue Dec 8, 14:00 PST for the customer demo. Action items:
- Carter: running SI dry-run at 13:30 PST (CloudSI only) — we will provide a separate join link and notes.
- Karthik: you own the data-flow slide + telemetry note requested by AWS (quick bullet points ok).
- Lauren: will manage the speaker mic plan and confirm the Zoom/Webex pass-through.*
- Marissa: can you add the final calendar invite and tag the HubSpot deal?

I've attached the runbook and exported the calendar file (calendar-proposed-times.ics) — I'll send the final invite after we confirm the two small runbook edits (data-flow bullets + one-line retention policy).

Jordan
Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Cross-cloud co-sell demo — coordinating Azure + GCP SI windows

On Mon, Dec 6, 2026 at 08:47 -0800 Jordan Blake wrote:
> Great — locking in Tue Dec 8, 14:00 PST for the customer demo. Action items:
> - Carter: running SI dry-run at 13:30 PST (CloudSI only) — we will provide a separate join link and notes.
> - Karthik: you own the data-flow slide + telemetry note requested by AWS (quick bullet points ok).
> - Lauren: will manage the speaker mic plan and confirm the Zoom/Webex pass-through.*
> - Marissa: can you add the final calendar invite and tag the HubSpot deal?

Thanks — I'll draft the two bullets now and upload them to the runbook folder. To pre-empt AWS questions:
1) Data flow: demo uses a synthetic customer dataset; no PII, routed through our hosted inference in us-east-1; logs for debugging are ephemeral and scrubbed after 24 hours.
2) Telemetry/retention: we retain aggregate telemetry for service health for 90 days; no raw request logs are stored beyond 24 hours without customer consent.

Uploading updated runbook and will ping when done.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Product — Redwood Inference
